steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Esperanza Spalding is a bassist-vocalist-composer — her music fuses jazz, funk, Brazilian and classical traditions, exemplifying contemporary fusion.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: I Know You Know features a catchy jazz-pop melody with sophisticated harmony, bass-driven groove and vocal-bass interplay.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Little Fly sets a poem by William Blake to music — the word painting (music illustrating text meaning) demonstrates sophisticated compositional technique.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: I Adore You combines Brazilian-influenced rhythm with jazz harmony and pop accessibility — it demonstrates Spalding's genre-crossing approach.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always use PRECISE musical vocabulary — not vague descriptions like it sounds nice Reference SPECIFIC musical elements when analysing any piece For listening questions: identify elements FIRST, then explain their effect For study pieces: know the context, structure and key features in detail For performing: focus on accuracy, expression and interpretation For composing: show development of ideas, not just repetition
